title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: A request to a 3D-printer assistant makes 2 model calls. The base (instructions, tools, question) is 2,000 tokens. After call 1, the program runs a tool that returns 3,000 tokens, and call 2 sends everything so far. Ignoring the model's own short requests, how many input tokens are billed for the whole request?
One call to the assistant sends 25,000 input tokens. Input tokens cost $2 per million. How much does the input of that one call cost, in dollars?
On Monday a student tells the assistant they are certified on the vinyl cutter. On Thursday, in a new session, the assistant asks them to prove it. Which explanation fits?

options.text: Monday's window was discarded and nothing was saved outside it
The model forgot because its window filled up overnight
Thursday's call is billed separately so it cannot see Monday
The assistant never reads files, so notes cannot work at all

items.stem: In a retrieval setup where the model calls a search_manual tool, what actually runs the search over the stored chunks: the model or your program?
A teammate wants the assistant to save "resin printer is free Saturday" in a student's notes file so it can answer faster next visit. What is the best objection?

options.text: A notes file cannot hold a short sentence like that
Saving a note costs more than resending the calendar
Bookings change, so the note goes stale; use a tool call
The model cannot read a note written in an earlier session
